description: Verify that TCP in LAST-ACK returns ACK with proper SEQ/ACK numbers after receiving a segment with OTW SEQ or unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p37). 2 iterations exercise CASE 1 (OTW SEQ) and CASE 2 (unacc ACK)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of UNACCEPTABLE_11 for LAST-ACK (passive-close path).

[Scenario — chronological]
Two phases. For each: tester FIN first → DUT enters CLOSE-WAIT → user CLOSE → DUT FIN → LAST-ACK. Then tester injects OTW-SEQ / unacc-ACK. DUT corrective ACK.

[Pass condition]
Both phases produce corrective ACKs.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: handshake / close-wait ACK / DUT FIN / probe ACK missing.

verdicts.Pass: DUT corrective-acked in LAST-ACK (OTW + unacc) — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to OTW-SEQ in LAST-ACK
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_probe_ack: No DUT ACK to unacceptable ACK in LAST-ACK
